paras: From a single landmark billboard to a fully coordinated out-of-home program, Kosick Communications helps brands own the streets where their customers live, commute, and shop. With more than 40 years buying media across Canada, we secure premium billboard, transit, and digital placements in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, and high-traffic markets nationwide. Outdoor advertising still does something no other channel can match: it puts your message in the physical world at full scale, impossible to scroll past or skip. The difference between a forgettable placement and one people remember comes down to location, timing, and creative, and our team manages all three. We study traffic patterns and audience data to choose sites with real impact, negotiate rates directly with media owners to protect your budget, and handle creative production so every panel looks its best. Whether you want to dominate a single neighbourhood, build awareness across a province, or launch a national campaign, we turn physical space into measurable brand attention and lasting recall.

headings: How much does outdoor advertising cost?
How do you choose billboard locations?
What is the minimum campaign duration?
Can I track the performance of my billboard campaign?
What creative formats and sizes are available?
Do you handle creative production for billboards?
paras: Billboard costs vary by format and location. Street-level placements start from approximately $550/month, classic billboard posters from $900/month, transit advertising from $1,000/month, and superboards from $1,500/month. Premium high-traffic locations command higher rates. We negotiate the best rates across our vendor network.

We analyze traffic volume data, demographic profiles, commuter patterns, and proximity to your points of sale. Our team maps competitor placements and identifies high-impact locations that align with your target audience and campaign objectives.

Most outdoor campaigns run a minimum of 4 weeks, which is the standard posting period. However, digital out-of-home can offer shorter commitments. We recommend 8-12 week campaigns for optimal brand recall and frequency.

Yes. We measure impression counts, traffic lift studies, website traffic correlation, QR code scans, and custom URL visits. Post-campaign reports include brand awareness metrics and recommendations for future placements.
